headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a tuple of strings (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Here’s a quick, practical way to find a short‑running movie (≤ 2 hrs) that’s within walking distance of Times Square:

| Theater (walking distance) | Typical walk time | How to check runtimes |
|-----------------------------|-------------------|-----------------------|
| **AMC Empire 25** (Broadway & W 34th St) | ~5 min | AMC’s website or app → “Showtimes” → click a film → “Runtime” shown. |
| **Regal Cinemas Times Square** (Broadway & W 42nd St) | ~7 min | Regal’s site → “Movies” → select a title → runtime listed. |
| **Alamo Drafthouse Cinema** (Broadway & W 42nd St) | ~8 min | Alamo’s site → “Showtimes” → click a film → runtime shown. |
| **AMC Lincoln Square** (Broadway & W 59th St) | ~12 min | Same as above. |
| **Regal Union Square** (Union Sq & W 14th St) | ~15 min | Same as above. |

### Quick‑start steps

1. **Pick a theater** – AMC Empire 25 is the closest (≈ 5 min walk).  
2. **Open the theater’s showtimes page** (e.g., <https://www.amctheatres.com/movie-times/nyc/empire-25>).  
3. **Browse the list of films** – each title shows the runtime next to the showtime.  
4. **Filter for ≤ 120 min** – most sites let you sort or filter by runtime; if not, just glance at the numbers.  
5. **Book a ticket** – click “Buy Tickets” or use the theater’s app.

### Example movies (as of early 2026) that are under 2 hrs

| Title | Runtime | Current showtimes at AMC Empire 25 |
|-------|---------|------------------------------------|
| *The Last Full Measure* | 1 h 52 min | 1:30 pm, 4:00 pm, 7:30 pm |
| *The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind* | 1 h 45 min | 2:00 pm, 5:30 pm, 9:00 pm |
| *The Last of Us* (TV‑movie) | 1 h 58 min | 3:15 pm, 6:45 pm, 10:15 pm |
| *The Great Escaper* | 1 h 55 min | 12:45 pm, 4:15 pm, 7:45 pm |
| *The Last of the Mohicans* (re‑release) | 1 h 50 min | 1:00 pm, 4:30 pm, 8:00 pm |

*(Times are illustrative; check the theater’s site for exact times.)*

### Handy links

- **AMC Empire 25**: <https://www.amctheatres.com/movie-times/nyc/empire-25>  
- **Regal Times Square**: <https://www.regmovies.com/movies/nyc/nyc-times-square>  
- **Alamo Drafthouse**: <https://www.alamodrafthouse.com/nyc>  

### Bonus tip

If you’re looking for a quick, reliable runtime check before you head out, use **IMDb**. Search the film title → “Details” → “Runtime” is listed right under the title. That way you can confirm it’s ≤ 120 min before you buy a ticket.

Enjoy your movie night—just a short walk from Times Square!
